notes: Dost 5.1 — Language fix: ab Dost wohi language bolta aur likhta hai jis mein aap baat karein — Roman Urdu mein sawal, to jawab bhi Urdu mein; English mein sawal, to jawab English mein. Hindi bilkul khatam: na screen par, na awaz mein, na search ke jawabat mein. 'Business WhatsApp open karo' ab sahi app kholta hai (search mein gum nahi hota), aur 'WhatsApp updates do / kisi se message aaya' par chat list parh kar batata hai kis ke kitne naye message hain. Agar naam samajh na aaye to pehle poochhta hai, ghalat chat nahi dhoondta.
